messages:
jess: quick heads-up — customer reported the A/B rollout heatmap in Console is showing cohort counts flipped for several experiments. report: https://redir.company/issue/4523 :eyes:
tyler: which dashboard? rollout page or the per-experiment analytics?
jess: per-experiment -> the 'assignments by cohort' stacked bar. It shows 70% for variant B and 30% for A, but backend logs show the opposite.
samir: can you paste the experiment id and a sample request?
jess: exp_id=sku_search_relevancy_v4. Customer provided two sample eval calls (anonymized):
```
POST /v1/rollout/assign
{ "experiment": "sku_search_relevancy_v4", "user_id": "u_12345" }
=> { "variant":"A", "seed": 0.21 }
```
and another that returned variant A as well. UI shows them as B.
maria: I pulled the assignment logs and see assignment_key uses `user_id_hash % 100`. The analytics pipeline groups by `variant_key` coming from the ingestion layer. Could be a mapping issue between variant keys and labels.
jess: customer also attached a short video. link: https://uploads.company/4523/video.mp4 (they circled the bars).
eng-analytics-bot: alert: ingestion-service reported 504s processing event-batch 2026-03-08T11:22:00Z - retries succeeded.
samir: 504 around 11:22 — did the backfill job run? If ingestion retried and reordered events, group-by could have been applied after a key remap. I suspect a join to the variant metadata table used the wrong key (maybe `variant_label` vs `variant_id`).
tyler: I can repro locally in staging: heatmap flips when I run the join using label instead of id. Quick diff:
```
-- buggy join
ON events.variant_label = variants.label
-- correct join
ON events.variant_id = variants.id
```
maria: good catch. That would explain counts being attributed to the wrong label. Is this a recent deploy?
samir: deployment history shows a change 2026-03-07 23:11 that added label normalization for backwards compat. The change accidentally updated the analytics service to use `variant_label` for the join key.
jess: customer impact: two enterprise customers reported incorrect split percentages in Console; they opened support tickets. Need an incident ticket?
ops-oncall: triage: P2 for now (misleading metrics, not data loss). Rolling patch to analytics-service with correct join scheduled in 15m. Can we also run a rectifying backfill?
anna-product: please add product-impact notes. We need to communicate to customers with an explanation and ETA.
tyler: patch pushed to canary and validated against sample dataset — heatmap matches event logs now. Backfill plan: re-run aggregation for impacted experiments between 2026-03-07 22:00 and 2026-03-08 12:00. SQL to rerun: 
```
INSERT INTO experiment_aggregates (experiment_id, variant_label, cohort, count, window)
SELECT e.id, v.label, cohort, count, window
FROM raw_events re
JOIN variants v ON re.variant_id = v.id
JOIN experiments e ON re.experiment = e.name
WHERE e.name = 'sku_search_relevancy_v4' AND re.ts BETWEEN '2026-03-07' AND '2026-03-08';
```
samir: schedule backfill for low-traffic window and mark the original erroneous aggregates as superseded. I'll open an internal incident note and assign follow-ups.
jess: thanks. I'll reply to the customers with a short explanation: variant labels were mis-joined in analytics after a metadata normalization deploy; we have a patch and a backfill ETA ~2h. Apology and offer extra audit logs. :pray:
maria: add a unit test for the join and a quick flag to validate join key in CI so this doesn't regress.
eng-analytics-bot: deploy to production succeeded for analytics-service at 2026-03-08T12:05:00Z :white_check_mark:
ops-oncall: backfill started at 2026-03-08T12:10Z, progress 0% -> 100% in ~35m.
tyler: verified aggregate counts after backfill — matches assignment logs. Closing loop.
jess: I'll update both support tickets with the resolution and close after customer ack. Great response, team. :tada:
